name: MemberGlut – Role & User Management
author: AppGlut

sections.description:
🚀 Transform your WordPress site into a powerful membership platform with MemberGlut!

MemberGlut is the ultimate membership management solution that empowers you to create sophisticated user hierarchies, implement granular access controls, and monetize your content like never before. Whether you’re launching a premium community, educational platform, or exclusive content site, MemberGlut delivers enterprise-level functionality with WordPress simplicity.

✨ 🎯 Key Features That Set Us Apart:

🔐 Advanced Role Management
* Create unlimited custom member roles with unique capabilities
* Intuitive drag-and-drop role hierarchy system
* Fine-grained permission controls for maximum flexibility

👥 Smart Membership Control
* Automated role assignments based on user behavior
* Time-based membership expiration and renewals
* Comprehensive member lifecycle tracking

🛡️ Content Protection Made Easy
* Protect posts, pages, and custom content types
* Customizable restriction messages and redirect pages
* Seamless integration with existing WordPress content

📊 Professional Admin Experience
* Beautiful, responsive admin dashboard
* Real-time membership analytics and reporting
* Bulk member management tools for efficiency

🌍 Built for Growth
* Translation-ready with complete .pot file included
* Developer-friendly hooks and filters for customization
* Optimized for performance and scalability

🎖️ Ready-to-Use Member Tiers:

⭐ Basic Member – Perfect starter access with essential reading permissions
💎 Premium Member – Enhanced experience with premium content access
👑 VIP Member – Ultimate access to all exclusive content and features

🚀 Unlock Premium Power (Pro Features):

💼 Business Essentials
* Unlimited custom roles and capabilities
* Advanced content restriction engine
* Automated membership renewals and notifications

💰 Revenue Generation
* Seamless payment gateway integration
* Subscription management and billing
* Advanced pricing models and discounts

📈 Growth & Analytics
* Comprehensive member analytics dashboard
* Import/Export tools for member management
* A/B testing for membership funnels

🎨 Enhanced User Experience
* Custom registration and login forms
* Personalized member dashboards
* Email automation and member communications

🏆 Perfect Solution For:
🌟 Membership & Subscription Sites
🎓 Online Learning Platforms
💼 Professional Communities

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/memberglut directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the MemberGlut menu in your WordPress admin to configure the plugin
  4. Create your first custom member role or use the built-in roles
  5. Start assigning roles to your users and managing content access
sections.faq:
How do I create a custom member role?

Navigate to MemberGlut > Roles in your WordPress admin dashboard. Click “Add New Role” and configure the role name, capabilities, and permissions according to your needs.

Can I restrict specific content to certain member roles?

Yes! MemberGlut includes content restriction features. You can set which roles can access specific posts, pages, or custom content types.

What happens to existing users when I activate the plugin?

Existing users keep their current WordPress roles. You can then assign additional MemberGlut roles to enhance their access or migrate them to custom member roles.

Is MemberGlut compatible with other membership plugins?

MemberGlut is designed to work independently but can coexist with other plugins. However, conflicts may occur if multiple plugins try to manage the same user roles or capabilities.

How do I upgrade to the Pro version?

Visit https://appglut.com to learn more about MemberGlut Pro and upgrade options. The Pro version includes advanced features like payment integration and unlimited custom roles.
